description: An existing metadata record about a dataset, as a repository or catalogue holds it. The input a quality or validation agent assesses. Slots are the DCAT and Dublin Core terms a minimal record carries; TODO widen when a real repository export is exercised.

schema_class.description: Type designator: the name of the class this object is an instance of. Discriminates the input and payload unions, and lets a consumer name a payload class it does not recognise.

identifier.description: The record's own identifier, e.g. a DOI or a catalogue URI.

licence.description: The licence the record declares, as an IRI or SPDX identifier.
